verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents its own hosted MCP server. Through it, AI assistants can query events, funnels, flows, retention and session replays in natural language with "no dashboard navigation required", and can take actions such as Create-Dashboard. The homepage also describes AI agents that monitor the product and surface insights. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language operation beyond querying and dashboard creation (e.g., configuring reports, cohorts, settings), a documented native in-app natural-language command interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language workflows work well.
